detail.longDescription: So, now there is this new shit available, these "AI". Everybody can now spit their wishes into the big Grand Theft Autocomplete-Machine and Claude et al vomits out their own personal software. No need or incentive to learn to code or to understand software architecture at all. "Software as a Service". So I ask myself, where is the point in coding or becoming better at coding. Seems pointless now. 🧵 2/5 # noai # coding # programming # retrocomputing # homecomputer
